global.cycle: Global crop protection is in a multi-year downcycle after the 2022-23 boom: channel destocking, low crop prices and Chinese generic oversupply. PI's MD (Aug-2026): 'early signs of demand and stabilization'; 'I have not seen such a long gestation period of the cycle'; generics pressure continues with global agchem companies.

innovatorsH1_2026.fact: Crop Protection sales US$6.6 bn, +4% (-1% at constant FX); Latin America -11% on pricing pressure, high channel inventory and destocking (Argentina); North America -4%; Brazil +7% despite pricing pressure.

innovatorsH1_2026.company: Kumiai Chemical (pyroxasulfone/AXEEV originator; PI's largest CSM customer)
innovatorsH1_2026.fact: H1 sales forecast raised 10.9% because AXEEV shipments were 'brought forward ... ahead of the entry of generic versions of our main product, AXEEV, into the U.S. market'.

Full-year operating profit forecast cut 62.5% (¥7.2 bn → ¥2.7 bn) on 'loss on valuation of inventories resulting from a decline in market prices caused by the entry of generic versions of herbicide AXEEV in markets outside Japan'; 9M operating profit -26.7%; AXEEV shipments to Australia and Argentina fell, US rose on sales promotion.
Statement that it holds valid North American patents on pyroxasulfone key intermediates, process and compositions and has enforced them since 2024.

industry.pyroxasulfone: PI's largest product, made for Kumiai. Brokers describe it as off-patent (Prabhudas Lilladher, May and Aug-2026). Kumiai's own filings confirm generic entry outside Japan and in the US in 2026, with falling market prices. PI's largest customer's revenue fell from Rs 3,540 cr (FY25) to Rs 2,556 cr (FY26).

exports.growth: -20% in FY24, +8% in FY25; India 3rd largest exporter; 7-9% CAGR FY25-28 (CRISIL)

monsoon2026.fact: June-September 2026 monsoon ended ~12.6% below normal ('deficient', IMD 30-Sep-2026), the weakest since 2015; PI said in Aug-2026 that sowing had caught up to last year's level after a delayed start.

industry.chinaPricing: Glyphosate still ~70% below its peak (I-Sec, Apr-2026); Gulf conflict and Chinese export curbs raised input costs 10-25% in Mar-Jun 2026, easing from June (SUMICHEM research file). PI: 'increase in input material price due to geo-political issues impacted gross margin' (Q1FY27).
industry.cdmo: PI: 'slowdown in biotech funding and geopolitical challenges' (Q1FY27 presentation); CRDMO is a 'long gestation J-curve'.

moat: Process chemistry and scale in CSM
30 years of agchem CSM; 8 plants, 130+ unit processes, flow chemistry; 20 molecules commercialised in recent years; 25+ innovator customers.
Real, but contract-based: the customer owns the molecule.
One customer = 38% of FY26 revenue (44% in FY25); its product (pyroxasulfone) faces generics.
Rs 356 cr R&D (5% of FY26 revenue); 250+ patents; first own molecule (Pioxaniliprole) awaiting registration.
Long-standing brands (Nominee Gold, Biovita); 15,000+ distributors; volume +12% in Q1FY27 vs peers.
Can fund losses in new businesses and acquisitions.
Sub-scale (Rs 300 cr revenue), loss-making (EBITDA -Rs 149 cr), Rs 110 cr impairment of the investment.
critiques: Concentration in pyroxasulfone, now generic: one customer was 38% of FY26 revenue and fell 28%
